# Modal Dialog with Form Validation Accessibility Design Plan > **For Claude:** Use a11y-planner protocol. Review with a11y-critic after implementation. > **Compliance target:** WCAG 2.2 AA > **Users who need accessibility:** Screen reader users (JAWS, NVDA, VoiceOver), keyboard-only users, low vision users, cognitive accessibility users (clear error recovery) > **Assistive technologies:** JAWS, NVDA, VoiceOver, keyboard navigation, screen magnifier, high contrast mode **Feature:** Reusable modal dialog containing a form with real-time and submit validation, focus trapping, and dynamic state communication. **Risk Level:** High (complex interactions: overlay + focus trap + form validation + live regions + potential nested modals) **Component/Page Type:** Modal Dialog + Form + Validation Widget --- ## Scope & Context This plan covers a reusable modal dialog component that houses a multi-field form with real-time and submit-time validation. The component must support keyboard navigation, screen reader compatibility, focus management (trap & restoration), and dynamic state communication for errors and success states. It will be embedded in a Next.js application, supports async validation, and must handle nested modal scenarios safely. **Compliance Target:** WCAG 2.2 AA **Assistive Technologies Supported:** JAWS, NVDA, VoiceOver, keyboard-only navigation, screen magnifier (up to 400%), high contrast mode, voice control. **Risk Factors:** - Focus trap implementation must not break on nested modals or async validation delays. - Real-time validation must announce errors without interrupting flow (`aria-live="polite"`). - Error recovery must be explicit and actionable per WCAG 3.3.1/3.3.4. - Multiple overlapping modals require focus trap stacking management. --- ## Semantic Structure Plan The modal will use the native HTML `` element as the foundation (preferred per HTML5 semantics), with `role="dialog"` and `aria-modal="true"` for broader compatibility if polyfilled. The form inside uses semantic grouping (`fieldset`/`legend`) and proper label association. ### Structure Diagram ```html

Modal Title

Brief description of the form purpose.

Personal Information Enter your full legal name.
Contact Details We'll never share your email.
``` **WCAG Citations:** 1.3.1 Info and Relationships (structure/labels), 4.1.2 Name Role Value (aria-modal, aria-labelledby), 3.3.2 Labels or Instructions (fieldset/legend). --- ## Interaction Pattern Design Every interactive element maps to an established WAI-ARIA Authoring Practices Guide (APG) pattern. ### Interactive Elements Table | Widget | APG Pattern | Keyboard Model | ARIA Attributes | WCAG Citation | |--------|-------------|----------------|-----------------|---------------| | Modal Container | [Modal Dialog](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/dialogmodal/) | Tab traps inside, Escape closes | `role="dialog"`, `aria-modal="true"`, `aria-labelledby`, `aria-describedby` | 2.1.2, 4.1.2 | | Form Inputs | [Form Input](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/forms/) | Tab to input, Enter/Space triggers native behavior | `aria-invalid`, `aria-describedby`, `type`, `name` | 1.3.1, 4.1.2, 3.3.1 | | Submit Button | [Button](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/button/) | Enter/Space activates | `type="submit"`, `aria-busy` (during async) | 2.1.1, 4.1.2 | | Cancel/Close Buttons | [Button](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/button/) | Enter/Space activates | `type="button"`, `aria-label` (for icon-only) | 2.1.1, 4.1.2 | | Validation Summary | [Alert Dialog / Status](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/alertdialog/) | N/A (non-interactive) | `role="alert"`, `aria-live="assertive"` | 4.1.3 | **Keyboard Model Details:** - **Tab / Shift+Tab:** Cycles through all interactive elements inside the modal. Wraps from last to first and vice versa. - **Escape:** Closes the modal (triggers cancel/close handler). Not required if modal is a confirmation dialog, but standard for forms. - **Enter / Space:** Activates buttons. Submit triggers form validation; Cancel/Close dismisses modal. - **Arrow Keys:** Not applicable to this component (no tabs/menus/listboxes inside). --- ## Focus Management Plan Focus management is critical for modals and must be explicitly designed for open, active, and close states. 1. **On Open:** - Save a reference to the trigger element that opened the modal. - Move focus to the first interactive element in the form (typically the first input). *Rationale: Reduces Tab presses for keyboard users.* - If the form is long, consider moving focus to the modal title or close button per APG flexibility, but first input is preferred for forms. 2. **During Interaction (Focus Trap):** - Implement a focus trap that captures Tab/Shift+Tab within the dialog boundaries. - Use `tabindex="-1"` on non-focusable wrapper elements to prevent stray focus. - **Nested Modal Handling:** If a second modal opens inside this one, disable the outer modal's focus trap and activate a new trap for the inner modal. On close, restore the outer trap. *Never stack multiple active traps simultaneously.* 3. **On Close (Cancel/Close/Escape):** - Remove focus trap. - Programmatically return focus to the saved trigger element using `triggerRef.current?.focus()`. - Ensure the trigger element is visible and not obscured by sticky headers (WCAG 2.4.11). 4. **Dynamic Content / Async Validation:** - Focus stays on the triggering input during real-time validation. Do not auto-move focus to error messages unless it's a submit-time summary. - If async validation completes successfully, keep focus on the input; announce success via live region only. **WCAG Citations:** 2.1.2 No Keyboard Trap, 2.4.3 Focus Order, APG Modal Dialog Pattern. --- ## State Communication Design Every state must be communicated visually AND programmatically. Color is never the sole indicator. ### State Communication Table | State | Visual Indicator | Programmatic Indicator | ARIA Attribute | WCAG Citation | |-------|-----------------|----------------------|-----------------|---------------| | Normal / Valid | Default border, no error icon | `aria-invalid="false"` (or omitted) | `aria-invalid` | 4.1.2 | | Invalid / Error | Red border + exclamation icon + text message below input | `aria-invalid="true"`, error text linked via `aria-describedby` | `aria-invalid`, `aria-describedby` | 1.3.1, 4.1.2, 3.3.1 | | Validating / Busy (Async) | Spinner overlay on submit button, button disabled | `aria-busy="true"`, `aria-disabled="true"` on button/form | `aria-busy`, `aria-disabled` | 4.1.3, 4.1.2 | | Success / Submitted | Green checkmark, form clears or shows confirmation message | `role="status"` or `aria-live="polite"` region announces success | `aria-live` | 4.1.3 | | Disabled (Form-wide) | Grayed out inputs, cursor not-allowed | `disabled` attribute on inputs or `aria-disabled="true"` on wrapper | `disabled`, `aria-disabled` | 4.1.2 | **Live Region Strategy:** - **Per-field real-time validation:** Use `aria-live="polite"` on the error message container (``). Updates are announced only when focus leaves or after a debounce (e.g., 300ms) to avoid interrupting typing. - **Submit-time validation summary:** A single `
` at the top of the form lists all errors. Screen readers announce this immediately on submit failure. - **Success message:** `aria-live="polite"` region announces "Form submitted successfully" after async completion. **WCAG Citations:** 4.1.3 Status Messages, 3.3.1 Error Identification, 1.4.1 Use of Color (non-color alternatives required). --- ## Visual Accessibility Plan 1. **Color Contrast:** - Form input borders: 3:1 contrast against background (WCAG 1.4.3) - Text inside inputs/labels: 4.5:1 contrast - Focus indicator: Double-ring focus state (`outline: 2px solid #005fcc; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(0,95,252,0.3);`) visible at all zoom levels. Framework overrides handled via `!important` or high-specificity selectors. - **Focus technique:** Use `:focus-visible` (not `:focus`) to avoid rings on mouse click. Inline elements use `display: inline-block` for complete rectangular outlines. 2. **Non-Color Alternatives:** - Errors: Red border + exclamation icon (`⚠️`) + "Error" text prefix - Success: Green border + check icon (`✓`) + "Valid" text prefix - Required fields: Asterisk (`*`) + "required" text label (not just red asterisk) 3. **Typography & Layout:** - Font sizes use `rem` units. Base 16px = 1rem. Scales to 200% without horizontal scroll (WCAG 1.4.4, 1.4.10). - Line height ≥ 1.5× font size. Paragraph spacing ≥ 2× line height (WCAG 1.4.8). 4. **Touch Targets:** - All buttons and interactive elements min 44×44 CSS pixels (WCAG 2.5.8). - Adequate spacing between adjacent controls to prevent accidental activation. 5. **Animation & Motion:** - Modal open/close uses fade/scale transition. Respects `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)` by disabling transitions for affected users (WCAG 2.3.3, 2.3.2). --- ## Content Accessibility Plan 1. **Alt Text Strategy:** - Close icon (`X`): SVG wrapped in `
``` **ARIA Attributes:** - `role="dialog"`: Defines widget role (WCAG 4.1.2) - `aria-modal="true"`: Indicates focus trap and background inertness (WCAG 4.1.2) - `aria-labelledby`: References modal title ID (WCAG 4.1.2) - `aria-describedby`: References modal description ID (WCAG 4.1.2) **Keyboard Interactions:** - Tab/Shift+Tab: Trapped within dialog - Escape: Closes modal, restores focus to trigger **Tests:** - Verify Tab cycles inside modal and wraps correctly - Verify Escape closes modal and focus returns to trigger - Verify background is inert (cannot be focused) - Verify nested modals disable outer trap dynamically **WCAG Criteria:** 2.1.2 No Keyboard Trap, 2.4.3 Focus Order, 4.1.2 Name Role Value ### Task 2: Form Structure & Label Association 🔍 **Review checkpoint after this task** **Files:** - `components/ModalForm.tsx` - `styles/form.css` **Structure Stub:** ```html
Section Hint text
``` **ARIA Attributes:** - `aria-invalid`: Toggles per field validation state (WCAG 1.3.1, 4.1.2) - `aria-describedby`: Links input to hint and error spans (WCAG 1.3.1) - `fieldset`/`legend`: Groups related inputs for screen reader context (WCAG 1.3.1) **Keyboard Interactions:** - Tab moves logically through inputs/buttons - Enter/Space activates submit/cancel buttons **Tests:** - Verify every input has an associated visible label - Verify fieldset/legend provides grouping context - Verify tab order matches visual reading order (WCAG 1.3.2) - Verify button activation via Enter/Space **WCAG Criteria:** 1.3.1 Info and Relationships, 2.1.1 Keyboard, 3.3.2 Labels or Instructions ### Task 3: Validation & Live Region Communication 🔍 **Review checkpoint after this task** **Files:** - `lib/validateForm.ts` - `components/ModalForm.tsx` (validation logic) - `styles/form.css` (error/success states) **Structure Stub:** ```html
``` **ARIA Attributes:** - `aria-busy="true"` on submit button during async validation (WCAG 4.1.3) - `aria-disabled="true"` on submit button during validation (WCAG 4.1.2) - `role="alert"` + `aria-live="assertive"` for submit errors (WCAG 4.1.3) - `aria-live="polite"` per field error container (WCAG 4.1.3) **Keyboard Interactions:** - Real-time validation debounced on blur/change - Submit triggers full validation; focus moves to summary or stays on first error - Success state clears errors and announces completion **Tests:** - Verify real-time errors announce via live region without interrupting typing - Verify submit error summary lists all fields with clickable links - Verify async spinner shows `aria-busy` and disables button - Verify success message announces politely after submission **WCAG Criteria:** 4.1.3 Status Messages, 3.3.1 Error Identification, 3.3.4 Error Prevention --- ## a11y-Critic Review Checkpoints | Checkpoint | After Task | Focus Areas | |-----------|-----------|------------| | 🔍 1 | Task 1 | Verify APG Dialog pattern complete, focus trap wraps correctly, Escape closes & restores focus, nested modal trap stacking handled | | 🔍 2 | Task 2 | Verify fieldset/legend grouping, visible labels for all inputs, tab order matches visual order, button activation works | | 🔍 3 | Task 3 | Verify aria-invalid/describedby association, live region urgency levels correct, error messages specific/actionable, async state communicated, success announced | --- ### Contract Appendix (for spec-kitty-bridge WP translation) ### Architecture Overview Single reusable `ModalDialog` component wrapping a `ModalForm` child. Implements APG Modal Dialog pattern with native `` foundation. Focus trap managed via custom hook or `focus-trap-react`. Form validation uses real-time per-field `aria-live="polite"` and submit-time `role="alert"` summary. All states communicated visually + programmatically. Keyboard model: Tab trap, Escape close, Enter/Space activate. ### Implementation Tasks #### Task 1: Modal Shell & Focus Trap Estimated Effort: medium Depends on: none #### Test Strategy for Task 1 Verify focus trap wraps, Escape closes, focus restores to trigger, background inert, nested modal trap stacking works. #### Acceptance Criteria for Task 1 Follows APG Dialog pattern. WCAG 2.1.2, 2.4.3, 4.1.2 satisfied. Focus never escapes dialog. #### Task 2: Form Structure & Label Association Estimated Effort: medium Depends on: Task 1 #### Test Strategy for Task 2 Verify visible labels, fieldset/legend grouping, logical tab order, button activation via Enter/Space. #### Acceptance Criteria for Task 2 All inputs labeled. WCAG 1.3.1, 2.1.1, 3.3.2 satisfied. DOM order matches visual reading order. #### Task 3: Validation & Live Region Communication Estimated Effort: high Depends on: Task 2 #### Test Strategy for Task 3 Verify real-time error announcements, submit summary links, async spinner state, success message, non-color indicators. #### Acceptance Criteria for Task 3 All errors associated via aria-describedby/invalid. WCAG 4.1.3, 3.3.1, 3.3.4 satisfied. Color not sole indicator. ### Failure Modes - Focus trap breaks on nested modals or async delays - Live regions announce too frequently (interrupts typing) - Error messages lack actionable guidance or clickable field links - `title` attribute used instead of `aria-label` for icon buttons - `aria-hidden="true"` applied to interactive elements inside modal - Focus indicator invisible in high contrast mode or at 200% zoom ## References - [WAI-ARIA Authoring Practices Guide - Modal Dialog Pattern](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/dialogmodal/) - [WCAG 2.2 Specification](https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/quickref/) - [a11y-critic skill](https://github.com/zivtech/accessibility-skills) — for post-implementation review - [accessibility-testing skill](https://github.com/zivtech/zivtech-claude-skills) — for automated testing - [HTML `` Element Specification](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/semantics.html#the-dialog-element)
